thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert (P0) — host gpu-node-17 (us-west-2c) reported kernel panic + kubelet NotReady. PD incident PD-78912. Auto-escalation to oncall rotation. Logs attached: https://pagerduty.example/PD-78912

alex (oncall): ack — I'm on it, pinging eng-sre and infra. Starting SSH + kubectl checks.

alex (oncall): running `kubectl get nodes gpu-node-17 -o wide` and `kubectl describe node gpu-node-17` — node status: NotReady, taints: node.kernels/KernelOops:NoSchedule.

jen (eng-sre): saw the alert, checking pod states and k8s events. Are GPU workloads CrashLooping?

miguel (infra): looking at host dmesg — seeing NMI watchdog + soft lockup, NVidia driver stack trace and page allocation failures. I'll prepare for a controlled reboot if needed.

alex (oncall): any customer impact yet? @liz (cs) can you check customer reports?

liz (cs): two customers flagged 503s in the last 3m: acme-inc and beta-ops. Both on inference shard shard-07 (GPU). I'm opening support threads.

jen (eng-sre): metrics show inference error rate spike + tail latency increase for shard-07. Canary routing helped but spare capacity insufficient — estimated capacity loss ~18% for that shard. We should fail over traffic to spare-pool via routing runbook.

alex (oncall): proposed plan: 1) cordon node, 2) drain node (ignore-daemonsets), 3) if drain blocks force-delete stuck pods, 4) trigger routing fallback to spare pool. Who will run node ops?

miguel (infra): I'll take node ops. Commands I'll run: ```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-node-17
kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force\```

jen (eng-sre): I'll own routing — will flip internal route to spare-pool (runbook link). Also collecting pod eviction failures.

alex (oncall): handing roles: miguel = node, jen = routing, I'll stay on comms and customer updates. 20m before next escalation.

miguel (infra): cordon complete. drain started — most pods evicted. One pod `inference-gpu-xy` stuck Terminating, error: couldn't unmount nvidia-uvm: device busy. Logs: ```
Pod inference-gpu-xy: error unmounting nvidia-uvm: device busy
container runtime: stuck on preStop
```

jen (eng-sre): force-delete that pod to unblock scheduling: `kubectl delete pod inference-gpu-xy --grace-period=0 --force` — I'll prepare routing shift while you do that.

alex (oncall): liz, please update acme-inc with ETA ~30m and that we're failing over workloads.

liz (cs): message sent to acme-inc & beta-ops: "Engineers are failing over workloads; reduced errors expected within ~30 minutes." Will update if anything changes.

miguel (infra): force-delete succeeded. drain completed. Kubelet still NotReady; collecting journalctl -u kubelet logs. Initiating graceful reboot via IPMI now.

jen (eng-sre): routing flip executed — shifted 30% traffic to spare-pool, monitoring metrics. Error rate trending down, latency improving.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Host gpu-node-17 reboot completed and kubelet restarted. Node rejoined cluster as Ready. PD-78912 resolved by miguel (infra).

alex (oncall): great job. I'll open the incident ticket with timeline and tags (kernel oops + NV driver). Handoff: jen owns follow-up for driver rollback/upgrade and scheduling RCA; miguel owns hardware investigation. I'm off in ~15m, handing follow-up to jen.

jen (eng-sre): acknowledged — I'll schedule RCA and add required fixes to infra backlog.

liz (cs): customers updated and acknowledged, no SLA credit requests yet.

alex (oncall): closing thread for active mitigation. If anything regresses ping this thread or escalate PD. (reacted :thumbsup:)
